blockers2026_09_05.firstBad: cdf4f4de (2026-07-30 09:53:39) feat(codegen): if= Phase 2 — if= REMOVES from the DOM per §17.1
blockers2026_09_05.symptom: compiles at exit 0; throws `Cannot set properties of null (setting 'innerHTML')` at load in happy-dom AND real Chrome; 0 li.todo-item render
blockers2026_09_05.mechanism: if= branch content moved into a mount <template>; document.querySelector does not descend into template content, so the module-top-level `const _scrml_lift_tgt_N` binds null and the first _scrml_effect throws
blockers2026_09_05.minimalRepro: outer if= element + a for/lift list inside it + a NESTED if= in the row body (24 lines). Without the nested if= the emitter uses an inline form and the same shape renders fine.
blockers2026_09_05.relatedGap: g-call-expression-interpolation-in-if-chain-branch-renders-empty (resolved S400-peter) — its insideMountTemplate fix covered STATIC-DISPLAY binding sites, not the LIFT-TARGET site

blockers2026_09_05.symptom: benchmarks/bench-scrml.js and benchmarks/browser/bench-browser-pw.js call _scrml_reactive_set("todos", …) on the bare global key; chunk-namespacing keys cells "<token>$name" and the _scrml_cs_* accessors are chunk-IIFE-local, so the write lands on a key nothing reads — SILENTLY, no error
blockers2026_09_05.fix: mirror compiler/tests/helpers/chunk-scope.js chunkCellKey(): read the token from the `// --- chunk cell scope (xxxxxxxx) ---` prologue and key `<token>$name`

blockers2026_09_05.symptom: dist/ accumulates one content-hashed scrml-runtime.<hash>.js per compile (16 present, spanning Jun 24 - Sep 3); readdirSync().find() picked a 6-week-old one while app.html referenced the current one
blockers2026_09_05.fix: read the runtime name from app.html's own <script src> — compiler/tests/browser/browser-todomvc.test.js already does this (S345); benchmarks/ was not updated

blockers2026_09_05.cause: loadTodoMVC() swallows the client-init throw into an `initError` variable and no test asserts that a row ever renders; corpus-compile-floor checks exit 0, which the DOA build satisfies; no perf gate exists in CI

blockers2026_09_05.symptom: bun benchmarks/bench-scrml.js is SIGKILLed (exit 137) on a 15.4 GB machine; peak RSS > 2 GB
